evidence: Changes PSBT signing verification in `src/psbt.cpp`, which implements the PSBT handling covered by wallet.
rationale: Fixes a bug where `SignPSBTInput` rejects valid 65-byte Taproot `SIGHASH_ALL` signatures when `PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE` is absent. As noted in issue #36507, this causes `SIGHASH_MISMATCH` errors and prevents subsequent signing or finalization of valid PSBTs generated by external Taproot signers.
